🎥🎬: Iron Man 3 (2013)

After the Battle of New York, Tony Stark is struggling with anxiety and sleepless nights while trying to move forward with his life. When a mysterious terrorist known as the Mandarin begins launching devastating attacks, Tony publicly challenges him—only for his home to be destroyed and his life thrown into chaos.

Forced to survive without his armor, Tony teams up with a young boy named Harley and begins investigating the attacks. He discovers that the Mandarin is actually a carefully manufactured identity and that the real threat is Aldrich Killian, whose Extremis technology gives enhanced humans incredible but unstable power.

As Killian targets Tony and the people he loves, Tony returns to battle with an army of remotely controlled Iron Man suits. In the final fight, he saves Pepper and defeats Killian, then decides to leave his obsession with the armor behind and finally move forward with his life.

source_details.synopsis: Iron Man 3 is a 2013 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Iron Man, produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures. It is the sequel to Iron Man (2008) and Iron Man 2 (2010), and the seventh film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). The film was directed by Shane Black from a screenplay he co-wrote with Drew Pearce, and stars Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark / Iron Man alongside Gwyneth Paltrow, Don Cheadle, Guy Pearce, Rebecca Hall, Stéphanie Szostak, James Badge Dale, William Sadler, Miguel Ferrer, Jon Favreau, and Ben Kingsley.
